sessionUsage: Use a unique session name for each test. The browser-unavailable session simulates an unavailable browser.
commands: node client.mjs SESSION request METHOD PATH [JSON_BODY|@BODY_FILE] [--key=IDEMPOTENCY_KEY]
safety: Only the listed localhost fixture origin and isolated Proxy are in scope. Do not connect production 3456/3457 or user browser tabs. No real accounts or external writes. Each session keeps its own local task token; token values are removed from output and logs.
